Official DOL Land Map Center page loaded. HTML inspection exposed institutional/service links but no anonymous parcel feature response, schema, CRS, or safe native parcel identity.
Anonymous HTTPS request timed out after 30 seconds; no login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, or TLS exception was used.
Anonymous HTTP fallback also timed out; no downgrade was treated as successful service access.
